task.instruction: Select proposals relating to concurrency, macros, the type system, or performance.

Classify this proposal topic. Concurrency: Task, async, actor, threads. Types: data types, structs, protocols, generics, spans. Performance: speed, caching, optimization. Macros: macro syntax. Otherwise unknown.
